capabilities: resolve GFM kebab-case heading links on click across files
support hover page preview for GFM links
insert GFM slugs with heading aliases via autocomplete
configure display prefixes and suffixes for autocomplete output
disambiguation: Not a link formatter or exporter; it resolves GFM slugs at runtime without modifying files.
extras: Detailed architecture and GFM spec documentation is hosted externally, not in the README. The README lists known limitations, including reliance on undocumented Obsidian autocomplete internals that may break duplicate-heading collision suffixes.
intentEvidence: This plugin bridges that gap. Links written in GFM format resolve correctly at runtime
problem: Obsidian's heading slug format differs from GitHub Flavored Markdown, so links written in GFM format are dead links and unresolved wikilinks.
summary: Link resolver that makes GFM-style kebab-case heading links (e.g. #my-heading) work in Obsidian at runtime, in both Live Preview and Reading view.
